scope: Native per-bin chunk prefix and global-offset addition
tolerance_reason: Every word is compared exactly against native cooperative Rust shaders and an independent integer/stable-sort specification.
preconditions: Rust-derived u32 layouts; nonaliasing buffers; finite bounded allocation and launch dimensions
Capacity <= 64 million keys per batch, <= 1024 reduced histogram entries per batch; validated active counts and fixed native 4-bit shifts
Synthetic >1M-key histogram fixtures are restricted to reduce/scan/add stages and do not imply sorting that many runtime keys was tested.
invariants: Stable ordering preserves original order of equal keys and the associated values/auxiliary fields
All intermediate, readonly, inactive, padding and guard words are checked exactly
Cooperative GPU phases include explicit workgroup barriers; serial CPU phases are a separate execution adaptation
outside_scope: Ascend vendor compilation, execution, synchronization qualification and performance
Native flattened-batch host optimization; the tested sort runs independent native batch grids
